name: Smoked sausage
summary: Lạp sườn is the smoked sausage of both roads. The geopark pairs it with roast duck. A western-route article makes it from local black pork. A smoke time and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: The eastern road and the western road.
howToEat: The geopark’s 18 July 2025 article names lạp sườn hun khói with roast duck and olive sticky rice. Báo Cao Bằng on 22 March 2023 names lạp sườn from local black pork on the western route, with kitchen-hung pork and crisp belly. The 3 May 2026 article says people eat the smoked sausage or carry it home.
A smoke time and a price are Check on arrival. The May 2026 phở chua article also puts lạp sườn in the sour bowl.
where: Eastern route, western route, and the town bowl. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cao Bang smoked sausage — lap suon
seoDescription: Lạp sườn is smoked sausage on the eastern and western roads, and in the sour pho. A smoke time and a price are Check on arrival.
